data.title: Peet approval: approve CRM/entity tagging + multi-link implementation plan before build
data.description:

data.title: Theo: add tenant-safe document/project multi-link schema and validators
data.description:
Implement Phase 1 schema and validation for document/project many-to-many CRM links.

Acceptance criteria:
- ClientDocumentLinkSet supports companyIds, contactIds, clientOrgIds, projectIds, dealIds while preserving companyId/contactId/clientOrgId/projectId/dealId behavior.
- Project types support companyIds/contactIds/sourceCompanyIds/sourceContactIds/recipientOrgIds while preserving primary scalar fields and current claim/share semantics.
- Shared normalisation trims, dedupes, caps arrays, ensures primary scalar appears in its array, rejects invalid array values, and prevents unsafe cross-org links.
- POST/PATCH document and project APIs use the normalizer.
- Tests cover valid arrays, invalid arrays, scalar compatibility, and primary-in-array normalization.
